english.title: Operator of a food business deny request to be informed verbally of food establishment hygiene rating - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were the operator of a food business establishment, namely **(..SPECIFY ESTABLISHMENT..), when, without reasonable excuse, the request of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to be informed verbally of the establishment's food hygiene rating was denied
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 9(2)(a) and 20 of the Food Hygiene (Rating) Wales Act 2013.
